race.comment: COUPLES RETREAT (1) has been racing conssitently well and looking for her spot to land another win. This is the right race. Ratings are there and she just needs the splits to arrive at the right time. That is the concern, from one there is potentially a lot of horses around her, but she's got a change of speed. KIRRIBILLI (6) can be a big improver second up. She wasn't miles away fresh in a messy race on heavy going and now gets the blinkers back on which can help. Most recent win was second up. Second up is a bit of theme of the race. OLIVIA TWIST (13) ran well fresh and so did HEROIC DEED (12) who bolted up at Newcastle and is well worth a crack at these. THE LITTLE GENERAL (7) has the pace and rating pattern to offset his wide draw. Latest has him in the mix.
